description: This bar chart illustrates the effect of different masking strategies on several language groups. The horizontal axis represents language groups, labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language group, there are four bars representing different masking strategies: “mBERT-targ” (light blue), “XLM-targ” (dark blue), “mBERT-permute” (light gray), and “XLM-permute” (dark green). Each bar includes an error bar indicating variability. The “mBERT-targ” bars range in height from approximately 11 for “IE-other” to approximately 32 for “IE-Germanic”. The “XLM-targ” bars range from approximately 8 for “IE-other” to approximately 28 for “IE-Germanic”. The “mBERT-permute” bars range from approximately 10 for “IE-other” to approximately 30 for “IE-Germanic”. The “XLM-permute” bars range from approximately 5 for “IE-other” to approximately 22 for “IE-Germanic”. The bars are grouped by language, with each group containing one bar for each masking strategy. No bars are visually emphasized or sorted in a specific order.
